occAiFoundingBoundary.question: Can the selected AI city request occur without a current Settler, and where can OCC omit it before its selected side effects while preserving ordinary tile work and scan continuation?

scope.boundary: Selected AI caller prefix, tile-scan arm and continuation; complete city-distance helper and ordinary-unit-distance helper. Save and restore thunks, score helper and CityCreate are contracts that depend on conditions, or accepted evidence, not newly expanded bodies. No runtime, implementation or whole-AI caller census.

selectedPath.actor: The entry low32 r3 is copied to r16 and frame+0x1C4 at 82CB6E60..68. The selected scan reloads this p. Require a preserved canonical frame, 0<=p<8 and p different from the current controller word read through frame+0x5C,+0xB0 at 82CBBDCC..82CBBDF8. The accepted identity of the AI function does not prove natural execution or an actually loaded OCC setting.
selectedPath.coordinates: 82CBBD18..82CBBE54 initializes x=r24=1 and y=r29=1, then iterates the interior x<width-1,y<height-1. r22=40*x. These are tile-scan induction variables, not coordinates read from a current unit. The visibility, region or terrain plane names are not inferred merely from byte loads.
selectedPath.split: The byte comparison at 82CBBE3C and branch 82CBBE40 send byte 1 to ordinary arm 82CBC07C. The separate tile-plane byte comparison 82CBBE50 and branch 82CBBE54 also send nonzero there. Only the remaining arm reaches 82CBBE58. All later local branches in this selected arm end at 82CBC3D4 or 82CBC3DC, apart from its selected helper and creator calls.
selectedPath.admission: While the actual state is preserved, 82CBBE58..74 requires signed native remainder(turn+p,8)==0 with turn U32[8312B8DC]. It requires a zero per-actor and per-tile-group counter and clear selected tile-halfword bits. The first city-distance query excludes p; its distance and candidate-group predicates and score helper 82D02530 must accept. The own-mask city-distance query at 82CBBF34 must return a city j other than -1. Population and regional comparisons must pass before the ordinary-unit-distance query; its stored distance must exceed 2, terrain must avoid 0/6/7, and the later city-distance query's stored distance must exceed 1. Unknown actual inputs remain supplied-state premises.
selectedPath.sourceCity: 82CFF528 scans exactly 128 records C=8314FE28+188*j, considering only signed population C+3>0, current owner C+0!=-1 and an owner bit selected by r5; r6==-1 bypasses its optional plane filter. It returns the first strictly closest accepted ordinal, including 0, or -1, and stores its derived distance. The own-mask caller uses r5=1<<p. For valid p0..7, supported owner bytes -1/0..7 and preserved records this ties the returned source city current owner to p, independent of original-owner byte C+1. The caller rereads its population and coordinates and decrements that city's C+3 before requesting another city. This selected route therefore already requires a positive-population owned city and is an expansion route; no additional first-city history or count policy is needed to disable it.
selectedPath.unitQuestion: 82CFF8C0 searches ordinary unit slots by an accepted owner mask and writes a selected-distance result. The caller supplies tile X and Y, an owner mask and -1; it supplies no current-unit identity or type and ignores the returned unit ordinal. With positive player count 2 and every queried owner 1 ordinary-unit slot unoccupied (owner 0xFF), the exact helper finitely returns -1 and stores 999. That satisfies the caller's distance>2 check. Native execution of the accepted caller can then request CityCreate without any live ordinary unit in the supplied table. This establishes a unit-independent expansion case that applies only under conditions, not absence of Settlers in an observed game, a fog-visibility explanation or an executable-wide no-unit proof.
selectedPath.creation: 82CBC020..3C decrements the selected source-city population byte, reloads p into r28 from frame+0x1C4 and calls 82D18D88(p,x,y,1), returning to 82CBC040. The accepted creator searches 128 slots, returns -1 on exhaustion and returns a valid city ordinal only on its success path, which is reached only under conditions. At the selected AI caller, no result test separates return from the two counter updates. Results 0,127 and -1 all take those updates under the premises of a normal return and preserved values. A creator-only suppression or simulated -1 return would therefore leave unwanted population, cache and counter effects.

omittedEffects.helperRequests: Three city-distance requests 82CBBECC/82CBBF34/82CBC010, score request 82CBBF0C, ordinary-unit-distance request 82CBBFD4 and CityCreate 82CBC03C are all downstream of the selected check.
omittedEffects.distanceCaches: Each selected city-distance helper writes U32[830EE53C]. The unit-distance helper writes U32[830EE544] and, when replacing its best candidate, U32[830EE540] with selected owner. Its empty-unit case writes 999 to the distance and preserves the old selected-owner word. Native save and restore frame effects remain qualified separately.
omittedEffects.population: 82CBC02C stores low8(population-1) at source C+3 before CityCreate, using r31=188*j and r26=8314FE28+3.
omittedEffects.counters: 82CBC068 increments the word at B+4*(32*p+g), where B is the preserved frame+0x60 value (initialized 830E5AD0) and g is the current byte from the selected tile plane. 82CBC074 increments B+128*p. Neither update checks the creator result. The model keeps a stable supplied g; actual alias and helper preservation and live plane values remain premises.

disablementCandidate.enabled: Read the same current frozen game OCC enabled policy used by the reward and production rules through an owning occ::ForGame snapshot. If enabled, transfer control to 82CBC3D4 before executing the displaced instruction. This suppresses the entire accepted expansion arm before its helper cache stores, source-population decrement, creator and counters.
disablementCandidate.disabled: Execute the displaced instruction exactly once, then continue at 82CBBE5C with native state. The original condition-dependent splits and all native downstream predicates remain operative.
disablementCandidate.continuation: 82CBC3D4..D8 reloads width into r31, then flows into 82CBC3DC. The shared suffix increments y and r16 by 1 and 2, rereads height and compares y<height-1 before returning to 82CBBDC8. End-of-row 82CBC3F8..404 increments x and compares x<width-1 before 82CBBD8C; otherwise 82CBC408 keeps the later owner-control work. No call or loop-carried counter or population store is needed to enter this continuation.
disablementCandidate.preservation: Use a supported control-transfer hook point with canonical PC and unchanged code identity. Preserve all guest registers, CR/XER, FPR, frame and guest memory except native effects of the chosen continuation; in particular preserve x/r24,y/r29,tile pointer/r16, current frame and dimensions. The enabled callback must not execute the displaced lis or any skipped native instruction; the disabled callback must not replace existing native state. Host policy reads must return normally, be nonthrowing and have no guest-memory aliases. Concrete registration and generated insertion and callback preservation still need implementation and inspection.
disablementCandidate.exclusions: The two branches before this site that go to 82CBC07C remain unchanged, preserving this scan's ordinary nonfounding arm. Command12 Settle, accepted capture 82D1B784 and setup 82D23348/82D2378C/82D23904/82D2440C are separate origins and never this exact site. Shared CityCreate, existing city ownership, native load and deserialization and ordinary unit production are not globally suppressed. The existing production restriction remains separately required. No current-human, era, turn 0, mode 1 or current-city-count surrogate selects OCC.

occAiFoundingBoundary.conclusion: The accepted AI tile-scan expansion can request a new city from an existing owned source city without consuming a live ordinary unit in a supplied positive-player-count case. OCC can omit that entire selected arm at 82CBBE58 and preserve ordinary tile work and shared scan continuation. This is a concrete static disablement candidate, not an explanation proved for the owner's running game.
occAiFoundingBoundary.nextDiscriminator: Implement and inspect the exact pre-side-effect control transfer using the same current frozen game OCC policy, with disabled native equivalence and preserved continuation state. Default-off execution must distinguish enabled and disabled expansion requests, source-population, cache and counter preservation, ordinary tile work, setup, capture and load, and actual title and loadout identity. Implementation and runtime validation remain outside this static finding.

retainedInputs.owner: r20 is entry r3, copied at 0x82D18DC4. Validate signed city owner C+1 against p, with C=0x8314FE28+0xBC*j and 0<=p<8.
retainedInputs.x: U32[current SP+0x19C], saved from entry r4 at 0x82D18D9C; validate signed city halfword C+0x30.
retainedInputs.y: U32[current SP+0x1A4], saved from entry r5 at 0x82D18DA4; validate signed city halfword C+0x32.
retainedInputs.origin: U32[current SP+0x178]. CityCreate allocates 0x180 bytes at 0x82D18D94; save14 at 0x827F7C50 stores low32 entry LR at incoming SP-8 via 0x827F7C98. Require canonical reaching SP and frame and an unmodified saved word. Do not use current live LR, r25 or r6 as the origin.
retainedInputs.qualification: These are local dataflow locations, valid only when every intervening call returns with the required frame, register and city memory and their lifetime preserved. Re-read and validate the live city, snapshot inputs before the added call, preserve guest continuation state and execute the displaced instruction once.

foundingOnlyInsertion.successTest: CityCreate searches 128 records for first byte 0xFF. Exhaustion returns -1 at 0x82D18E88 through its separate unwind at 0x82D18E8C..94 and does not reach 0x82D1A314. This hook accepts only the preserved allocated-city tail, never a truthy slot test. The native command and AI callers themselves do not test for CityCreate returning -1 before all subsequent work.
foundingOnlyInsertion.commandIngress: 0x82CE031C..0x82CE03A8 selects the clear tile-bit 0 arm; the set-bit arm instead adds 20 to an existing city field and skips founding. Nonzero terrain and 0x82CF0C30 returning nonzero permit signed unit owner, X and Y plus mode 1 into 0x82D18D88. Return PC 0x82CE03AC preserves the city ordinal in r3, then copies it to r26 at 0x82CE03B0. No local human-only or Settlers-type 0 test is claimed.
foundingOnlyInsertion.aiIngress: Accepted AITurnUnitEvaluation function 0x82CB6E48 reaches 0x82CBC03C after its selected tile, nearby-city and helper predicates at 0x82CBBE50..0x82CBC024. Call inputs at 0x82CBC028..38 are mode 1, r29 Y, r24 X and frame+0x1C4 owner reloaded into r28. Return PC is 0x82CBC040. These local AI checks, helper return and preserved actual inputs remain conditions.
foundingOnlyInsertion.modeIsInsufficient: Disproved as a discriminator: byte 0x8314F10B nonzero at 0x82D18E48..54 forces copied mode r25 to 0 even for the two admitted mode 1 callers.

foundingOnlyInsertion.captureReconstructionLoad: The accepted capture call 0x82D1B784 and setup calls 0x82D23348/0x82D2378C/0x82D23904/0x82D2440C fail the two-PC whitelist. Reconstructed and setup cities through other origins and ordinary deserialization receive no grant at this hook. This is an origin check, not proof of a universal indirect and tail caller census or a replay-proof semantic city-founded event.
foundingOnlyInsertion.onceAndAllPlayerGate: Exactly one extra allocation per accepted successful invocation follows from one guarded hook execution and one call. Universal human and AI founding coverage, network authority, delivery and replay, reentrancy and durable once-per-city identity remain unobserved. Validate both routes and exclusions in the executing title; do not replace this gap with city or nearby-unit counts or a saved unit-slot index.

creator.verdict: depends on conditions; nonnegative slot alone disproved as a complete live-object test
creator.call: 0x82D11750(p,7,x,y), with validated actual owner and coordinates. U=0x830F2BF0+0x54*(256*p+j). The ordinary path accepts type 7 while the preserved definition flags at 0x82F70534 are 0x20 (bit 2 clear).
creator.return: Signed32 r3==-1 means exhausted 256 instance slots; 0 is valid. Accept 0<=j<256, then verify the preserved U.owner==p,U.type==7,U.slot+0x30==j,U.X/Y==x/y and live record and object identity before writing effects. No unit should be synthesized by a raw table write on failure.
creator.initialization: The accepted exact 84-byte fill at 0x82D11820 clears +0x10. Later local stores initialize owner, type, coordinates and slot and rank+5=1; movement helper 0x82CF1F70(p,7) at 0x82D118C8 must complete and preserve these inputs. Its Settlers 0 proof does not automatically close Militia 7.
creator.firstCallback: Current receiver A=0x8314F76C; at 0x82D11980 current vtable+0x1A0 is dispatched. Initialized target 0x82D7FE40 receives U, allocates 224 bytes at 0x82D7FE64, and on nonnull allocation calls 0x82D99BB0 at 0x82D7FE74. Null sets O=0 but later dereferences it: no clean Boolean allocation failure is established.
creator.constructor: 0x82D99BB0 first calls base constructor 0x82C61970 at 0x82D99BC4, then installs vptr 0x82135DB0 and U at O+0x84. Its additional 20-byte allocation at 0x82D99C68 and child, reference and string writes must complete without aliases invalidating U, O or the frame. It returns O at 0x82D99CDC. Actual base and helper effects and lifetime remain requirements.
creator.objectAcceptance: 0x82D80208 dispatches current O+0x14. Preserved initialized cell 0x82135DC4 points to 0x82D9A110, a three-instruction tail adapter to 0x82D99EB8. That body loops three definition+0x48 model bits; a selected arm allocates 192 bytes at 0x82D99F28, calls 0x82D9B6E0, dispatches current child+0xB0 at 0x82D99F68, reference-adjusts child+8, calls 0x82E79810, appends via 0x822DB7A8 and registers via current manager 0x8314F2C0 ->0x82C78D68 at 0x82D9A010. Child rejection dispatches +0xC and returns 0 at 0x82D9A0D8; accepted local tails return 1 at 0x82D9A0AC/0x82D9A104 after 0x82D997E8/string work. Those child and manager returns, finite vector bounds, names, current targets, alias separation and object lifetime are not yet shown; local 1 is not transitive registration proof.
creator.publication: If O+0x14 returns low8 zero, 0x82D8022C destroys O through current+0xC and 0x82D80238 sets U+0x3C=0 before normal callback return. This is why a later returned j can name a record without a preserved object. Nonzero takes an O+0x74 vector traversal that runs only when its conditions hold, calling 0x82D9B080 for nonzero children, publishes O to U+0x3C at 0x82D8029C and calls 0x82D5CB70(owner,slot) at 0x82D802B0. That helper resets per-unit auxiliary state and lifecycle word+0xC, destroys an old manager child only when its condition holds, and returns through 0x82D5CC90; it is not itself a proof that every registration persists.
creator.laterCallbackAndReturn: 0x82D11984 rereads A.vptr after the first callback; 0x82D1199C dispatches its current+0x1B4. The preserved initialized target 0x821D5678 is exactly blr. Then 0x82D119B0/B4/B8 write U+7=0xFF,U+0x26=0xFFFF,U+0x14=0. The second session-child+0x100 call at 0x82D119D8, if reached, must return a readable owner source. Under preserved type 7 and flags 0x20, bit 0x80 is clear at 0x82D119FC..0x82D11A08, so optional+0x1C0/+0xD0 work is bypassed. 0x82D11AC8 returns j and unwinds. If callbacks mutate the live type, vptr, definitions or owner or session state, that bypass and initialized+0x1B4 target must be re-established.
creator.retentionGates: Require every allocation, helper and current dispatch to return normally, correct finite counts and readable targets, disjoint stack, record, object and manager writes, stable owner, type, slot and coordinates, and U+0x3C==O with O+0x84==U preserved through the final creator return and grant. A nonzero pointer is necessary evidence of the selected publication, not sufficient proof of a registered live unit. Do not retry automatically after partial object failure: the logical slot may already be occupied and retrying can add another unit.
creator.nextGate: The first new open question along the transitive path is the actual 0x82D3DBA0 allocation and the preserved values of the 0x82C61970 base constructor, followed by the actual selected 0x82D9B6E0/current+0xB0/0x82C78D68 registration and later child and manager lifetime. No whole creator success proof or runtime execution is claimed.

loyalty.verdict: proved representation and rank-neutral local grant; combat and persistence paths that depend on conditions
loyalty.grant: After the common creator and both mandatory callbacks return with the validated same live U, use a big-endian 32-bit read, OR and write U+0x10 |=0x8. Preserve other bits, rank+5 and movement+2. Do not invoke earned command22, which spends rank. Any grant before 0x82D11820 is erased.
loyalty.canonicalEvidence: unit-special-upgrades.json#/loyaltyDefenseBoundary and #/persistence are canonical for the defense link and exact default-stream word transfer.
loyalty.ordering: Allocate after the native CityCreate defender work and successful city tail; grant after creator callbacks and validation. Later native OR8 is idempotent for the bit but cannot deduplicate unit creation. Creation-time presentation copied before the grant is not proved refreshed; if immediate UI display is required, separately tie its upgrade reader and refresh to the display.

duplicates.verdict: proved selected local distinction; transitive absence that depends on conditions
duplicates.nativeDefender: CityCreate 0x82D19AD0 calls 0x82CFE828, stores its selection to city+0x38 at 0x82D19AEC and calls the common creator at 0x82D19C4C only for a nonbarbarian owner and configured start turn!=0. If it selects 7, the native and extra units are both Militia; two such units are intentional under the selected policy. Do not replace the native request or suppress the extra unit based on nearby or type counts.
duplicates.uea26: The accepted OR8 writer 0x82D15C74 belongs to CityUpdate production continuation 0x82D13978, after that function's unit creation. It is not on CityCreate's direct grant continuation. It requires cumulative UEA26, live-slot definition flags&6==0 and nonzero attack, plus a defense>attack comparison using a separately cached production-item offset. Preserve that offset-equality qualification. Initialized Militia 7 has signed attack 0 and defense 1 at 0x82F70524/25, so its nonzero-attack check is false if the live type and definition are preserved. No civilization lookup is needed for the custom non-specialized Militia grant.
duplicates.otherSelectedWrites: The inspected 0x82D7FE40 callback writes U+0x3C and, only under conditions, rank+5; its local code has no Loyalty OR. Its rank arm 0x82D80300..54 also requires positive attack and is bypassed for unchanged Militia 7. 0x821D5678 writes nothing. 0x82D5CB70 writes auxiliary state and lifecycle+0xC, not special upgrades+0x10. This local observation, limited to the inspected scope, does not exclude writes by opaque allocation, string, model, manager or session helpers, current replaced vtables or later gameplay.
duplicates.unitVsBit: An OR8 repeated on the same live unit does not allocate a second unit or spend rank. One extra unit per founding requires event delivery and execution identity, independently of that bit idempotence.

verification.method: Foreground tools/run-headless.ps1 -ReadOnly, canonical project serialized; DumpFunctions.java output was treated as truncated metadata, never complete semantic decompilation. DumpMemoryWords.java supplied raw native words within the inspected scope; FindDirectCallers.java supplied the declared raw BL inventory. Native operands were decoded as Xenon/PPC64 big-endian.
verification.qualification: The word total includes unclaimed incidental neighbors. Only the selected windows and branches above were interpreted. Generated span hashes are LF-normalized UTF-8 bytes from the exact own header inclusive to the immediate next header exclusive, with no body reading of a whole generated source file.
verification.refusalReason: Each selected function was the last physical header in its generated source file and lacked a next header. Their bodies were not read or searched; native word windows and accepted evidence for these functions were used instead.
verification.runtime: No new runtime observation, title/API implementation, save-format change or multiplayer guarantee.

Independently validate the two accepted founding routes and capture, setup and load exclusions in the executing title.

nextResearchTarget.boundary: This gameplay contract does not reopen unit-definition-base.json#/findings/RVA-F-0301/nextResearchTarget ordinary body, owner and block coverage, additional-type capacity, N, closed reader searches or turn-sync.

conclusion: The non-specialized type 7 Militia requirement has a founding-only success-tail insertion that applies only under conditions, with preserved inputs, a creator slot test and explicit live-object requirements, a rank-neutral Loyalty OR, and selected defense and save-load contracts. Complete creator lifetime and universal exactly-once human and AI delivery still depend on conditions that are not established. Separate Scout and new-definition, exact-five cost, future-turn March, presentation and synchronization boundaries remain open.

minimumScoutSupportBoundary.status: minimum title support requirements established; neither registration backend is admitted as a safe existing API
minimumScoutSupportBoundary.appearance: Reuse non-specialized Militia appearance, icons, models and animations as the placeholder, with the Scout display label separate. No custom asset authoring is required; correct routing still requires implementation and validation.

identity.verdict: disproved as a current registration or per-instance variant API
identity.result: The static civilization and base-type resolver cannot distinguish Scout from non-specialized Militia of the same owner and base type. Assigning a new integer or mapping every Militia to Scout is insufficient.

effects.verdict: proved mechanism, delivery depends on conditions
effects.result: Named special grants preserve rank; March writes bit 0x40 and adds 3 internal movement units, equivalent to one displayed movement point. A Scout-specific selector and every-creator delivery are not supplied by the static identity API. The native Scout upgrade is not the new Scout unit.

cost.verdict: disproved as a current absolute-five API
cost.result: Current rules express additive percentages over the composed scalar. For inherited signed factor 1, final scalar 10 or 11 gives five by truncation; choosing final 10 after all relevant modifiers is sufficient arithmetic, subject to shared display, AI and completion delivery and actual Scout identity.

persistence.verdict: depends on conditions, no per-instance tag interface in the audited surface
persistence.result: The audited interfaces expose no live variant key or per-unit serialization or replication interface. This is an API result limited to the audited surface, not a global title absence claim.

native39.gates: No in-place 38 append, count-only bump or spare special-unit reuse. Native relocation requires the still-open complete consumer, alias and count, name and appearance, lifecycle and codec contracts; no new ID 38 acceptance is inferred.

militiaBackedLogicalVariant.verdict: smaller candidate that depends on conditions, not a safe existing path
militiaBackedLogicalVariant.gates: Keep a distinct title-owned Scout identity while the native record remains type 7. Carry that identity through candidate selection and current production, every explicit Scout creation, display and name routing, supported save and load and network state. Invalidate or reassign it on runtime owner or slot reuse. Concrete army formation must preserve the intended logical identity; no army-split API or unsupported transfer behavior is assumed. Non-specialized native, scenario and founding Militia must never acquire the Scout identity merely because it is type 7 or has March.

titleImplementerContract: Publish one mod-scoped logical Scout definition inheriting standard Militia 7 for every unspecified property, named Scout, trainable by accepted human and AI production, with exact final cost 5 and Militia appearance. Existing non-specialized Militia remains separate.

Use the same Scout identity in build-list labels, AI candidate and selection state, current-city production, cost queries and completion. Preserve candidate capacities and native selection and callback ordering. The current static catalog and percentage API require extension; no public API name or layout is selected here.

For an explicit Scout creation, invoke the accepted native creator with the accepted backing type and preserved owner, X and Y. Treat -1 as failure and 0 as a valid slot; validate the returned range 0..255 and the same live unit, owner, type, coordinates and object before publishing its logical identity or effects. Callback return, registration and lifetime remain exact requirements in foundingMilitiaContract/creator and unit-definition-base.json#/findings/RVA-F-0301.

Grant March rank-neutrally after native upgrade-word clearing and budget initialization: set 0x40, exclude starting 0x8 and add 3 internal movement exactly once. Carry this policy through every Scout creator caller. Keep the separate UEA26 fresh-live-type and attack 0 check or explicitly exclude the Scout identity at its writer; do not use the earned command22 that spends rank.

Keep native, scenario and founding defender requests as non-specialized Militia; attach Scout identity only for an explicit Scout production or creation request. Do not rename or change every native type 7 record, reuse a special unit, assume an unused guest bit, or infer identity from March alone.

Before advertising supported persistence, round-trip Scout and non-specialized Militia distinctly through save and load, runtime-slot recreation and each supported multiplayer path. Preserve the default native upgrade-word transfer qualification. This is a domain acceptance requirement, not a framework-wide mandatory sidecar, new-game or loadout-mismatch policy.
minimumScoutSupportBoundary.acceptance: A small Scout mod can declare the approved policy once the title provides the identity, production, common-creation and lifecycle services. Required checks distinguish non-specialized, automatically granted Militia from a trained Scout, show cost 5 in human and AI contexts, preserve rank and March and no Loyalty at creation, route Militia visuals, and preserve identity in supported saves and network modes. Existing interfaces do not already implement this contract.
minimumScoutSupportBoundary.qualification: The focused contract does not close the parked exhaustive native census, choose or implement a backend, prove runtime delivery, or extend any public ABI. All earlier closed searches, limitations and source identities remain intact.

Assignment and current production, preview and native completion order; Settlers acceptance is not Scout acceptance.

menu.selection: 0x82E01690 stores the selected native item after an ordinal bounds test; the invalid arm 0x82E016B4 stores -1. The native field supplies no second logical key for multiple equal items.
menu.confirmation: 0x82E02CF0 loads parent+0xC40, dispatches child virtual+4 at 0x82E02D00, and reloads the child at 0x82E02D04. Native equality at 0x82E02D20/0x82E02D24 skips a change helper, separately from the low-byte callback-result action arm leading to 0x82E02D94->0x82CEE650. Confirmed submission is not disproved by that equality.
menu.initializedPoll: Initialized vtable 0x82125548 slot+4 contains 0x82E01728. Its selected normal-return poll produces 1 exactly when child byte+8 is zero. The parent action arm takes a zero low-byte result, only when the same child, target and frame are preserved. An optional refresh call 0x82E017B0->0x82E014F0 remains opaque; initialized table data does not prove a live instance preserves that target.
menu.qualification: The sole-alias policy can derive a trusted candidate 7's definition without a per-row definition map. Actual child, category, city and list validity, empty rebuild, whether values are preserved across intervening callbacks, and confirmation and request revalidation still matter. No executing Scout menu was observed.

carrierPath.scope: Static carrier of native item 7 from the human menu row to the city current-item store, with the AI and general submit path. Source corroboration is from generated code; no Scout menu, flag or command was observed.
carrierPath.menuCopy: Generated source narrows the row copy to 0x82E01680 (scale row), 0x82E01688 (load item) and 0x82E01690 (store item to production child +0x448). These two addresses come from generated code, not from word reads of the image. The confirmation handler compares the selected value with parent +0x434 at 0x82E02D20; equality skips the change helper 0x82E02C50, while the separate confirmation arm can still call the producer at 0x82E02D94. Metadata updated only by the change helper would miss a same-value row change; suppression of a human confirmed command is not proved.
carrierPath.menuChild: The production menu child is allocated by its actual parent at 0x82E01960, constructed by 0x82DFC528 and stored at parent +0xC40; do not identify it with another UI object because offsets match. Parent category arrays are 400 bytes apart with the unit array at parent +0x44C, and the child receives a count, array, category and city index. 0x82DFF310 rebuilds the child vector at +0x430, copying accepted 32-bit item values for categories 0 to 2. The selection callback checks the parsed row against (child+0x438 - child+0x434)/4 before the copy to +0x448 (RVA-F-0185/ownership).
carrierPath.handler: 0x82E02CE0 reads category +0x440 and item +0x448. Its unit branch 0x82E02D94 -> 0x82CEE650 forwards owner, city and item without a category-zero conversion and without the row ordinal as an extra definition key (RVA-F-0184/choiceHandler).
carrierPath.candidateList: Generator 0x82CEBC38 fills scratch 0x8312D7B0 with 32-bit item words; native unit emission is A[T++]=type, so each unit type is visited once. Human wrapper 0x82CED7E8 (mode 1, fixed 100-word scratch) skips S leading negatives, copies (100-S)*4 bytes and returns T-S, so original row a maps to copied row a-S.
carrierPath.aiAndGeneral: AI evaluator 0x82CB44E0 returns an ordinal into the same populated list and may append wonder items; the ordinal is not a unit type or persistent key. The ordinary submit helper rereads fixed A by ordinal and ignores the caller's array pointer. Equality of selected item and signed city +0x38 exits at 0x82CB44B0 without a command. General producer 0x82CE1950 builds the same five record positions, and mr r6,r7 at 0x82CB44BC forwards the selected item.
carrierPath.commandRecord: Human producer 0x82CEE650 builds (5, owner, city, item, U32[0x82F7AD00]). The fifth word has a live source and is not spare storage. The 32-slot, 20-byte command ring queues commands and is not a city build queue. A constructed command is not delivered production.
carrierPath.currentItemWrite: Command 5 stores the low halfword of record +0x0C at city +0x38 at 0x82CE0020 after the owner match and the 0x82CB3F08(city) call; the helper return is not tested (RVA-F-0183/staticCommandCase). Preview substitution in 0x82CE9490 saves the item at 0x82CE9DF8, substitutes a candidate at 0x82CE9DFC and restores at 0x82CE9E20 without committing (RVA-F-0183/previewDistinction). The assignment helper can read the old current item before the native store, so new context cannot be published at submission.
carrierPath.automaticOrigins: CityCreate current store 0x82D19AEC and native grant 0x82D19C4C are Militia, not Scout, when the selected defender type is 7 (the selection can be Modern Infantry 11). Automatic current-item origins at zero-mode 0x82D163BC -> 0x82CF1060 and successful reselection 0x82D160F8 can preserve a stale Scout tag when the native 7 is equal.
carrierPath.aiBypass: With Militia attack byte 0, item 7 and the documented inputs, the zero-attack and item-not-28 branch at 0x82CB6754..0x82CB6764 takes the same bypass as the accepted type 0 case, and after the classifier calls 7 satisfies signed item < 100. Under those premises it skips the five direct current-item stores. This is inferred from occ-settler-production-requirements.json#/assignmentAndQueueBoundary/aiEvaluator and unit-definition-base.json#/findings/RVA-F-0277/countAndModelContinuation/definitionCopyBaseline, not shown for actual Scout selection, total return or absence of alias writes. Do not apply it to a tagged item or altered definition.
carrierPath.recreation: The selected 0x82CD77E8 recreation creates a destination, writes definition movement, makes opaque callbacks and kills the source. Its 0x82CD7954 store (from generated code, not from word reads) is not demonstrated next-turn replenishment; same-unit, upgrade and first-reader transfer remain open.
carrierPath.historicalObservation: The earlier runtime observation saw building and wonder values at the command 5 store. It did not observe Scout selection, a logical identity field, complete delivery or same-native-type transitions.
carrierPath.qualification: Direct and literal producer censuses do not exclude indirect or earlier-constructed ordinary command 5 item 7 requests, so global absence is not claimed. The writer census is deliberately incomplete; do not turn its indexed-store exclusions or early decoded prefixes into an exhaustive census.
